title: Rewrite AN-6/AN-8 regression tests to exercise real app_shell.dart / persistent_switcher_scaffold.dart instead of hand-copied replicas
rule: TQ-8 (regression test must actually guard the fix)
why: Both files were written to pin fixes for shipped, user-visible bugs (AN-6: DASHBOARD nav label truncates at font_scale 1.3; AN-8: a signed-in account chip overlays the sign-in screen), but neither imports the file it claims to guard. app_shell_an6_test.dart's only imports are flutter/material.dart and flutter_test.dart — it defines and tests _ShellNavItemReplica, a hand-copied literal duplicate of the real (private) _ShellNavItem in lib/app/router/app_shell.dart:341-365; today the two happen to share the same padding/margin values, but nothing keeps them in sync. persistent_switcher_scaffold_an8_test.dart's only import is flutter_test.dart — its _authRouteNames set duplicates the literal set inside the real _isAuthSurface() at lib/app/router/persistent_switcher_scaffold.dart:92-98, and every assertion (e.g. expect(_authRouteNames.contains('SignInRoute'), isTrue)) is tautologically true by construction, since the test built the set itself. Repo-wide grep confirms no other test imports persistent_switcher_scaffold.dart for this scenario, so this is the ONLY regression coverage for AN-8, and it is vacuous: if a future edit drops 'SignInRoute' from the real _isAuthSurface() set (reintroducing AN-8), both this test and app_shell_an6_test.dart's counterpart would stay green while the bug ships again.
recommendation: For AN-6, pump the real AppShell/_ShellNavItem widget tree (as test/core/navigation/app_shell_test.dart already does for other AppShell scenarios) instead of a private replica class. For AN-8, either widget-test PersistentSwitcherScaffold directly with a router stub set to each route name, or extract _isAuthSurface's route-name set into a small @visibleForTesting top-level constant the test imports, so an edit to the real set changes the test's actual input.
acceptance_criteria: app_shell_an6_test.dart imports and pumps the real _ShellNavItem/AppShell widget, not a private replica.
persistent_switcher_scaffold_an8_test.dart imports persistent_switcher_scaffold.dart, and temporarily removing 'SignInRoute' from the real _isAuthSurface() set turns the test red.
